name: Mushrooms Kinoko
source:
Mushrooms is a visual novel being developed by one man. It's a story about an ancient continent of Lemuria experiencing its last hours. No one knows about the upcoming incident except for a strange 22-year-old girl who - despite this knowledge - seems to have no interest in keeping the world safe.

[From [url=https://ninep9up.itch.io/mushrooms]itch.io[/url]]
